title: NPS dropped the request: the NAS is not a registered RADIUS client (System log event 13)
plain_english: NPS received a RADIUS packet from an IP address that is not configured as a RADIUS Client and discarded it without answering. From the NAS's side this looks like a timeout. Nothing about users or policies is evaluated until the client entry exists.

causes.cause: The NAS is not in NPS > RADIUS Clients, or is registered under a different IP (NAT, secondary interface, a DHCP address that changed).
causes.next_check: Copy the IP from the event and add or fix the RADIUS Client entry; on the NAS pin the RADIUS source interface so the address stays stable.

causes.cause: A whole subnet of access points sends directly to NPS but only the controller is registered.
causes.next_check: Either register the address range (NPS accepts CIDR ranges in the client address field) or configure the access points to send via the controller.
